subject: Draft mutual plan: milestone owners, RACI checks, proposed target close
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft mutual plan: milestone owners, RACI checks, proposed target close

Ellen — thanks again for the call today. Quick follow-up with the draft MAP attached (MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and an annotated SOW for legal review. Summary of the items we captured and the asks we need from your side: 

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 1 (Mar 22–26): Security intake + SOC2 data transfer review — owner: Acme security (Dave Lin) — dependency: completed SOC2 evidence
- Week 2–3 (Mar 29–Apr 9): Integration sprint (API keys, test dataset) — owner: Redwood eng (Ben Carter) — dependency: access to sandbox and sample data
- Week 4 (Apr 12–16): Pilot assessment & acceptance criteria signoff — owner: Acme product (Ellen)
- Week 6 (Apr 26): Production cutover target (final close) — owner: Acme IT / Redwood shared

RACI asks (please confirm names/roles):
- Economic buyer: ?
- Security owner: Dave Lin (you mentioned him on the call) — pls confirm
- Legal reviewer / contract owner: ? (procurement@acme-fin.com in copy)
- Engineering lead for integration: ?

Proposed target close: Apr 26 (we can move earlier if legal/procurement are comfortable).

Please: (1) confirm the four role assignments above, (2) note any milestone changes in the attached MAP, and (3) confirm whether Acme will require a redline to the SOW or a separate PO process.

Attachments: MAP_v1.2.xlsx (master milestones), SOW-draft.pdf (for legal).

Next steps from Redwood: we will update the MAP with any role changes and circulate a second pass for signoff. If it helps, Ben can run a short tech sync this week to unblock the integration dependency.

Thanks —
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-fin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com, Dave Lin <dave.lin@acme-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft mutual plan: milestone owners, RACI checks, proposed target close

Thanks Olga — appreciated the clear summary and the MAP file. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Role confirmations:
- Economic buyer: Sara Liu, Head of Data (sara.liu@acme-fin.com) — she will sign the commercial term sheet.
- Security owner: Confirmed — Dave Lin (copied). He will own the security intake and provide SOC2 evidence.
- Legal / procurement: procurement@acme-fin.com is the primary; legal will want to review the SOW and may push for a standard confidentiality clause.
- Eng lead: I’ll nominate Marcus Chen (marcus.chen@acme-fin.com) as the point for the API integration.

2) Timeline: procurement has a two-week review window for standard SOWs. Realistically, we can target a close in the week of Apr 19 (signing), with rollout into prod by Apr 26. If legal has substantive redlines, plan will shift.

3) Attachments: I’ve attached our internal SOC2 checklist (Acme_SOC2_checklist.xlsx) — Dave, can you confirm completeness?

4) Procurement ask: We require a one-page commercial summary for procurement to avoid a full RFP. Can you provide that?

Quoting the relevant section from the MAP that I updated in the file: 
> Integration sprint owner should be Redwood eng (Ben Carter) but Acme eng (Marcus Chen) must assign an API test lead.

I’ll wait for your updated MAP and the one-page commercial summary.

Best,
Ellen
Sr. Product Manager — Data Platform
Acme Finance
ellen.park@acme-fin.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-fin.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft mutual plan: milestone owners, RACI checks, proposed target close

Ellen / team — quick tech note from Redwood eng:

We can support the proposed integration sprint in Weeks 2–3 but need the sandbox credentials and a small sample of the dataset (PII-redacted) by Mar 24 to hit the timeline. Action items I’m adding to the MAP:
- Redwood to provide integration runbook and test harness (owner: Ben Carter) — ETA Mar 19
- Acme to provide sandbox access and sanitized sample (owner: Marcus Chen) — ETA Mar 24

I also sketched a slightly shorter cutover path in the attached Miro (link above) that could allow pilot acceptance in the week of Apr 12 if legal turns quickly. For procurement, Olga — I can help with a short technical appendix to the one-pager (service boundaries, SLAs, data handling).

Ben
Principal Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 18:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft mutual plan: milestone owners, RACI checks, proposed target close

Appreciate the quick confirmations — summarizing agreed next steps and owners below (I’ll update MAP_v1.2 and re-circulate):

Agreed owners:
- Economic buyer: Sara Liu (Acme) — commercial signoff
- Security owner: Dave Lin (Acme) — security intake + SOC2 evidence
- Legal / procurement: procurement@acme-fin.com — SOW review
- Eng lead: Marcus Chen (Acme) — API test lead
- Integration owner (Redwood): Ben Carter — runbook/harness and technical appendix

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Redwood: technical appendix + one-page commercial summary for procurement (Olga + Ben) — ETA Mar 18
- Acme: sandbox creds + sanitized sample (Marcus) — ETA Mar 24
- Acme: legal review of SOW (procurement@acme-fin.com) — target complete by Apr 2
- Joint: kickoff sync to align on test cases (30–45 min) — propose Mar 25 or Mar 26; Ben to run
- Signoff target: execute contract week of Apr 19; production cutover Apr 26 (contingent on legal)

If everyone agrees, I’ll (1) publish MAP_v1.3 with the owner names and dates, (2) attach the one-pager and the technical appendix as a follow-up, and (3) open a DocuSign envelope for commercial signatures.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/req/abcd-efgh-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME/12345678
Drive MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Please reply with any corrections. If not, I’ll move ahead with MAP_v1.3 later today.

Thanks —
Olga
